plans.rationale: Initial investigation round. We need to check metrics and logs for the symptomatic services mobile-bff and payments-api to establish the exact symptom onset and nature of the UPI payment failures. Simultaneously, we need to inspect recent changes and the dependency graph around these services to identify any potential triggers.

tasks.goal: Check error rates, latency, and logs for mobile-bff and payments-api from 13:45 to 14:30 to establish the exact symptom onset and error details.

r1-observability-1.summary: Between 13:45 and 14:30 on 2026-10-02, an error rate anomaly began precisely at 14:03 on both mobile-bff and payments-api. payments-api threw NullPointerExceptions due to a null payer_vpa, causing mobile-bff to log upstream 500 responses.

findings.statement: mobile-bff error rate increased starting at 14:03 UTC, peaking at 6.29% at 14:09.
payments-api error rate increased starting at 14:03 UTC, peaking at 20.29% at 14:07.
payments-api CPU usage increased starting at 14:03 UTC, peaking at 48.63% at 14:19.
mobile-bff logged upstream 500 errors from payments-api starting at 14:03:01 UTC.
payments-api logged NullPointerExceptions due to payer_vpa being null starting at 14:03:05 UTC.

open_questions: Why did payer_vpa become null in PaymentIntentValidator at 14:03?

r1-dependency-2.summary: Retrieved deployment records and dependency maps for mobile-bff, payments-api, and upi-gateway. Found one recent deploy to payments-api (chg-9890) at 14:02, which is just prior to the reported symptom onset around 14:05.

findings.statement: payments-api depends synchronously on ledger-service, upi-gateway, fraud-service, and redis-cache, and asynchronously on event-bus.
upi-gateway depends synchronously on npci-switch and partner-bank-api.
mobile-bff depends synchronously on auth-service, payments-api, portfolio-service, orders-service, kyc-service, and aa-connector.
payments-api was deployed (chg-9890) at 2026-10-02T14:02:00+00:00 with refactored payment-intent validation and a bumped json library.
upi-gateway was previously deployed (chg-8605) on 2026-10-01T16:15:00+00:00 for minor bug fixes.

open_questions: Did the payment-intent validation refactoring in payments-api v2.14.0 introduce regressions in UPI payment flows?
Are external dependencies such as npci-switch experiencing increased latency or failure rates?

hypotheses.title: payments-api deployment code regression
hypotheses.mechanism: The deployment of payments-api v2.14.0 (chg-9890) at 14:02 UTC refactored payment-intent validation and introduced a NullPointerException when processing payer_vpa, causing API requests to fail with 500 errors starting at 14:03 UTC.

supporting.note: A deployment on payments-api occurred at 14:02 UTC, precisely one minute before the error onset.
payments-api error rate began rising steeply at 14:03 UTC.
payments-api began throwing NullPointerExceptions at 14:03:05 UTC in PaymentIntentValidator due to a null payer_vpa.
mobile-bff error rate increased starting at 14:03 UTC due to upstream dependencies failing.
mobile-bff logged upstream 500 errors from payments-api starting at 14:03:01 UTC.

assumptions: The refactored validation logic in payments-api v2.14.0 fails to guard against null payer_vpa values.

hypotheses.title: Simultaneous client payload change from mobile app
hypotheses.mechanism: Mobile clients simultaneously started omitting the payer_vpa field in their requests after lunch, causing payments-api to throw validation NullPointerExceptions.

supporting.note: The error specifically mentions that payer_vpa is null.

contradicting.note: A payments-api deployment occurred at 14:02 UTC, making a code-side validation change far more probable than an uncoordinated client payload change across all users at the exact same minute.

assumptions: Mobile clients changed their request payloads without a corresponding app store release or feature flag change.

hypotheses.reasoning_summary: The symptom onset is established precisely at 14:03 UTC across both mobile-bff and payments-api metrics and logs. A deployment of payments-api v2.14.0 (chg-9890) occurred at 14:02 UTC, directly preceding the error onset and the NullPointerException regarding payer_vpa in PaymentIntentValidator (log-00759). Hypothesis H1 is strongly supported by this temporal and causal link, while H2 remains an unlikely alternative.

adjustments.reason: Direct evidence from deployment chg-9890 at 14:02 UTC precisely precedes the error onset at 14:03 UTC, and log-00759 explicitly links the NullPointerException to the refactored PaymentIntentValidator in payments-api.
